what: Plan threads --allow-changelog-only through the Markdown sub-procedure but misses ship-pr.sh's independent run_rebase_rebump drop-bump-commit.sh call
scenario_or_breakage: Steps 10/12 no longer enter the Markdown sub-procedure; ship-pr.sh owns that path and would still call drop-bump-commit.sh without the new flag, so a CHANGELOG.md-only bump-subject commit can survive the drop, reintroducing the stale-bump conflict/stall despite the proposed fix
suggested_fix: Add --allow-changelog-only to scripts/ship-pr.sh's run_rebase_rebump drop-bump-commit.sh invocation, update scripts/ship-pr.md if it documents the call, and make the ship-pr regression test mandatory for the internal run_rebase_rebump path rather than only optional force-push-gate coverage
